acceptance: A confirmation is bound to the executing session's sign-in generation as well as the person, executor, session and exact request, so it does not survive a pause, resume, runtime change or principal switch.

positive.fixture: a confirmation given under the current sign-in runs once

negative.fixture: a confirmation given before reauthentication is refused after it; delegation withdrawn, self-delegation, agent confirming, widened request

security_and_source_permissions: Digest binds person, executor, session, request and sign-in generation; empty generation keeps the old digest.
performance_memory_storage: No cost beyond one session lookup per check.
known_limitations: Confirmer used-token set is in memory
